endpoints.description: Returns each expected artifact path with its existence/mtime, plus an overall fresh|missing status. Pure inspection — no mutation.

endpoints.summary: Generate or regenerate a flow's artifacts
endpoints.description: Runs the pipeline in generate mode for one flow. Returns the new artifacts status alongside the recorded run.
Removes every file under <flow-dir>/generated/. Refuses crafted paths that would escape the scenario root.
Walks the configured root and returns one entry per flow/flow.json with id, contract path, language, and schema version.
Returns the typed flow.json projection consumed by the UI's flow-detail page.
Creates a fresh flow directory with hand-authored transition + test sidecars. Replaces the legacy in-process CLI command.
Compiles every flow.json and returns the first compilation/contract error encountered, or empty on success.
Renders the markdown explanation consumed by the UI Overview tab and CLI explain output.
Runs the navigation kind's codegen (routes.generated.ts) and optionally writes the output to disk.
Walks the scenario's ui/src tree and asserts every route declared in code matches a spec route (and vice-versa).

endpoints.summary: Flow Studio descriptor for a navigation flow
endpoints.description: Returns the Flow Studio renderer payload (routes, affordances, containers, context toggles, invariant pass/fail) consumed by the UI's navigation graph view.
Returns API readiness plus dependency status (also mounted at /api/v1/health for client callers).

rest_exception.note: Plain GET /health for lifecycle systems, load balancers, and curl probes that cannot use a generated Connect client.

endpoints.description: Returns persisted verification history with optional flow_id filter and a configurable limit.
Returns one verification run including the counterexample blob on failure.
Walks <vrooli-root>/scenarios/* for .vrooli/service.json descriptors and returns one row per scenario.
Returns the scenario descriptor plus the flow summaries discovered inside it.

endpoints.summary: Generate every flow's artifacts in a scenario (server-stream)
endpoints.description: Server-streams one ScenarioArtifactsProgress per flow as artifacts are regenerated.

endpoints.summary: Clear every flow's generated/ tree in a scenario
endpoints.description: Removes every generated/ tree under the scenario root. Refuses traversal outside root.
Returns the local principal's persisted UI/CLI preferences. Hard-coded defaults are returned when no row exists; never NotFound.
Partial-update of the local principal's preferences. The FieldMask names which fields of the supplied Settings message are merged into the stored row.
Kicks off pipeline (discover → compile → artifact → codegen → lint) for one or all flows under the given root and returns the recorded run rows.
Returns status + result for one verification run.
